Name: Joja Furniture and Decor Pack - THRIVE Home Collection
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Did you buy the Joja Furniture Catalogue and notice something missing? No loveseat? No single bed? Not even a Joja TV?

[font=Arial]Fear not! Joja has once again expanded to meet your needs with the new [color=#3d85c6][size=4][b][i]THRIVE Home Collection™.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]

[b][i]What does it do?[/i][/b]
[list]
[*]Adds more Joja-themed furniture, wallpaper, and floors to the Joja Catalogue.[/*]
[*]Everything is added as new items with CP -- nothing replaces the vanilla Joja collection.[/*]
[*]The collection includes new loveseats, chairs, lamps, plants, wall decor, vending machines, TVs, and more. [/*]
[*]Even includes the wallpaper and flooring used in JojaMart, so you can bring a little piece of JojaMart into your farmhouse![/*]
[*]The TV, calendar, and vending machines are all fully functional.[/*]
[/list]Use this furniture pack in your own home, or in Pierre's shop. I don't care. Just don't forget to [i]THRIVE.™!!![/i]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url][/*]
[/list][b]A NOTE TO OUR CUSTOMERS:[/b]
Do you have an item you'd like to see added to the THRIVE collection? Feedback is welcome!
Write your request in the comments, along with your name, JojaMart account balance, and shares owned. The Joja Product Team will review your suggestion and decide if it's worth caring about! 💙
